# Indus civilisation and script research knowledge base

> Source-linked research on the Indus civilisation, its undeciphered script, urban archaeology, post-urban continuity, comparative Bronze Age societies and statistical evaluation methods. Complete inscribed-object records remain our first data priority alongside source-linked archaeological and comparative datasets. The script remains undeciphered.

- [README](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/index.html): purpose, findings and ways to explore.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/k-sandhu/indus-valley-script/blob/82521025e90485d0ee5a41b06aa9dc4f14391eda/AGENTS.md): agent rules and task routes.
- [Findings guide](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/findings/index.html): measured results by subject.
- [Working model](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/working-model/index.html): current claims and deciding tests.
- [Conjectures](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/conjectures/rules.html): claims, credences and predictions.
- [Questions](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/questions/index.html): open research and data tasks.
- [Data coverage](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/data.html): sources, gaps and priorities.
- [Repository map](https://github.com/k-sandhu/indus-valley-script/blob/82521025e90485d0ee5a41b06aa9dc4f14391eda/knowledge/MAP.md): navigation through the knowledge base.
- [Attempt registry](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/attempts/index.html): earlier work and retry conditions.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/contribute/index.html): ownership and review.
- [LOCAL_STORAGE.md](https://github.com/k-sandhu/indus-valley-script/blob/82521025e90485d0ee5a41b06aa9dc4f14391eda/LOCAL_STORAGE.md): local input storage and restoration.
